# ============================================================
# 0. SETUP
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)


model_dat <- dat %>%
  select(
    participant,
    condition,
    delay_ms,
    probability_rating,
    block,
    direction
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(participant),
    !is.na(condition),
    !is.na(delay_ms),
    !is.na(probability_rating)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

# Make sure variables have the appropriate types
model_dat$participant <- factor(model_dat$participant)
model_dat$condition <- factor(model_dat$condition)
model_dat$delay_ms <- as.numeric(model_dat$delay_ms)
model_dat$probability_rating <- as.numeric(model_dat$probability_rating)

# If block/direction are present:
model_dat$block <- factor(model_dat$block)
model_dat$direction <- factor(model_dat$direction)

# Inspect
str(model_dat)

# ============================================================
# 3. BLOCK EFFECT
# ============================================================

block_summary <- model_dat %>%
  group_by(block, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rating = mean(probability_rating),
    se = sd(probability_rating) / sqrt(n()),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

block_summary
## # A tibble: 4 × 5
##   block condition mean_rating    se     n
##   <fct> <fct>           <dbl> <dbl> <int>
## 1 1     intact           71.6  1.92   221
## 2 1     scrambled        53.3  2.32   203
## 3 2     intact           55.6  2.10   204
## 4 2     scrambled        68.3  1.96   221
ggplot(
  block_summary,
  aes(
    x = block,
    y = mean_rating,
    group = condition,
    color = condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_rating - 1.96 * se,
      ymax = mean_rating + 1.96 * se
    ),
    width = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Block",
    y = "Causal judgment",
    color = "Condition"
  )

# ============================================================
# 4. CONDITION × BLOCK DIAGNOSTIC
# ============================================================

block_lm <- lm(
  probability_rating ~ condition * block,
  data = model_dat
)

summary(block_lm)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = probability_rating ~ condition * block, data = model_dat)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -71.638 -21.564   4.665  26.362  46.709 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                           Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)                 71.638      2.032  35.257  < 2e-16 ***
## conditionscrambled         -18.347      2.937  -6.248 6.59e-10 ***
## block2                     -16.074      2.933  -5.481 5.59e-08 ***
## conditionscrambled:block2   31.118      4.150   7.498 1.64e-13 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 30.21 on 845 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.06433,    Adjusted R-squared:  0.06101 
## F-statistic: 19.37 on 3 and 845 DF,  p-value: 3.771e-12
anova(block_lm)
## Analysis of Variance Table
## 
## Response: probability_rating
##                  Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value    Pr(>F)    
## condition         1   1653    1653  1.8111    0.1787    
## block             1     61      61  0.0665    0.7966    
## condition:block   1  51296   51296 56.2192 1.639e-13 ***
## Residuals       845 771004     912                      
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
block_gam <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition * block +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "REML"
)

summary(block_gam)

  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    direction +
    s(delay_ms, k = 8) +

  method = "REML"
)

# ============================================================
# 6. BASIS DIMENSION: k = 6, 8, 10
# ============================================================

gamm_k6 <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, k = 6) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "REML"
)

gamm_k8 <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, k = 8) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "REML"
)

gamm_k10 <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, k = 10) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "REML"
)
gam.check(gamm_k6)

# ============================================================
# 7. COMPARE FITTED CURVES ACROSS k
# ============================================================

# Prediction data
newdat_k <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(
    min(model_dat$delay_ms),
    max(model_dat$delay_ms),
    length.out = 300
  ),
  condition = levels(model_dat$condition)
)

# Add participant variable so predict() has the correct structure
newdat_k$participant <- factor(
  levels(model_dat$participant)[1],
  levels = levels(model_dat$participant)
)

# Predictions
pred_k6 <- predict(
  gamm_k6,
  newdata = newdat_k,
  se.fit = TRUE,
  exclude = "s(participant)"
)

pred_k8 <- predict(
  gamm_k8,
  newdata = newdat_k,
  se.fit = TRUE,
  exclude = "s(participant)"
)

pred_k10 <- predict(
  gamm_k10,
  newdata = newdat_k,
  se.fit = TRUE,
  exclude = "s(participant)"
)

# Add predictions
newdat_k$fit_k6 <- as.numeric(pred_k6$fit)
newdat_k$fit_k8 <- as.numeric(pred_k8$fit)
newdat_k$fit_k10 <- as.numeric(pred_k10$fit)

# Reshape for plotting
curve_k <- newdat_k %>%
  select(delay_ms, condition, fit_k6, fit_k8, fit_k10) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("fit_"),
    names_to = "k",
    values_to = "fit"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    k = recode(
      k,
      fit_k6 = "k = 6",
      fit_k8 = "k = 8",
      fit_k10 = "k = 10"
    )
  )

# Plot
ggplot(
  curve_k,
  aes(
    x = delay_ms,
    y = fit,
    color = k,
    linetype = condition
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Temporal delay (ms)",
    y = "Predicted causal judgment",
    color = "Basis dimension",
    linetype = "Condition"
  )

# ============================================================
# 8. SAME VS. DIFFERENT TEMPORAL CURVES
# ============================================================

model_same_k8 <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, k = 8) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "ML"
)
model_diff_k8 <- gam(
  probability_rating ~
    condition +
    s(delay_ms, by = condition, k = 8) +
    s(participant, bs = "re"),
  data = model_dat,
  method = "ML"
)
anova(
  model_same_k8,
  model_diff_k8,
  test = "Chisq"
)
## Analysis of Deviance Table
## 
## Model 1: probability_rating ~ condition + s(delay_ms, k = 8) + s(participant, 
##     bs = "re")
## Model 2: probability_rating ~ condition + s(delay_ms, by = condition, 
##     k = 8) + s(participant, bs = "re")
##   Resid. Df Resid. Dev     Df Deviance Pr(>Chi)
## 1    815.78     391042                         
## 2    808.69     387172 7.0881   3870.6   0.3307
# ============================================================
# 9. DIAGNOSTICS FOR DIFFERENT-CURVE MODEL

summary(model_diff_k8)

## conditionscrambled   -2.827      1.499  -1.887   0.0596 .  
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Approximate significance of smooth terms:

# ============================================================
# 25. PROPER CI FOR INTACT - SCRAMBLED DIFFERENCE
# ============================================================

# Prediction grid
newdat_diff <- expand.grid(
  delay_ms = seq(
    min(model_dat$delay_ms),
    max(model_dat$delay_ms),
    length.out = 500
  ),
  condition = levels(model_dat$condition),
  block = levels(model_dat$block)[1],
  participant = levels(model_dat$participant)[1]
)

# Get model matrix for predictions
Xp <- predict(
  model_diff_block,
  newdata = newdat_diff,
  type = "lpmatrix"
)

# Covariance matrix of model coefficients
Vp <- vcov(model_diff_block)

# Predictions
pred <- as.numeric(Xp %*% coef(model_diff_block))

# Standard error for each prediction
pred_var <- rowSums((Xp %*% Vp) * Xp)
pred_se <- sqrt(pmax(pred_var, 0))

newdat_diff$fit <- pred
newdat_diff$se <- pred_se
# Separate intact and scrambled predictions
pred_intact <- newdat_diff %>%
  filter(condition == "intact") %>%
  arrange(delay_ms)

pred_scrambled <- newdat_diff %>%
  filter(condition == "scrambled") %>%
  arrange(delay_ms)
# Difference in prediction matrices
X_intact <- Xp[newdat_diff$condition == "intact", , drop = FALSE]
X_scrambled <- Xp[newdat_diff$condition == "scrambled", , drop = FALSE]

X_difference <- X_intact - X_scrambled

# Difference estimate
difference_fit <- as.numeric(
  X_difference %*% coef(model_diff_block)
)

# Variance of difference
difference_var <- rowSums(
  (X_difference %*% Vp) * X_difference
)

difference_se <- sqrt(
  pmax(difference_var, 0)
)

difference_dat <- data.frame(
  delay_ms = pred_intact$delay_ms,
  difference = difference_fit,
  se = difference_se
)

difference_dat <- difference_dat %>%
  mutate(
    lower = difference - 1.96 * se,
    upper = difference + 1.96 * se
  )
ggplot(
  difference_dat,
  aes(
    x = delay_ms,
    y = difference
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Temporal delay (ms)",
    y = "Predicted intact − scrambled difference"
  )
